item.title: Issue #2827 created
item.description:
Editorial Notes (August 2026 edition)

fn:map-to-element:

  • [x] example: dates → years
  • [x] Value conversions: item 5 contradicts the xml layout. It says the string “is parsed as an XML fragment and the resulting node is used as the element content”. But the forward layout serializes the element itself. It should say instead that the parsed element is the result, and that the map key is then redundant.
